status: frozen after the v19 observability gate and primary-source audit, before constructing a history source or reading any new lensing target
purpose: Test whether the spent MACS J0416 and PLCK G287 baryonic data contain one target-blind, genuinely time-ordered assembly observable that can be evaluated before proposing a causal Sigma source.

instantaneous_phase_space_controls.role: diagnostic control only; these statistics contain positions and line-of-sight velocities at one epoch and cannot count as a causal history coordinate
instantaneous_phase_space_controls.local_neighbor_count_rule: round(sqrt(N)), with the object itself added to each local neighborhood
instantaneous_phase_space_controls.velocity_gradient_definition: v_los=v0+a*x_east+b*y_north, with gradient magnitude hypot(a,b) and angle atan2(a,b) east of north
instantaneous_phase_space_controls.permutation_null: shuffle measured line-of-sight velocities over fixed projected positions

MACS0416.primary_event: the approximately 250 kpc northeast-southwest main-core pair
observational_summary: Jauzac et al. found distinct northeast and southwest redshift distributions and discussed both a near-first-passage scenario and a preferred prior-passage, turnaround, second-approach scenario.
Ogrean et al. found the main gas and mass centers aligned and interpreted the main pair as pre-merger.
The approximately 450 kpc south-southwest density discontinuity was associated with a smaller interaction, not a propagation clock for the main northeast-southwest pair.

primary_sources.title: Hubble Frontier Fields: The Geometry and Dynamics of the Massive Galaxy Cluster Merger MACSJ0416.1-2403
Frontier Fields Clusters: Chandra and JVLA View of the Pre-Merging Cluster MACS J0416.1-2403

PLCKG287.primary_event: the northwest shock and cold-front system
observational_summary: Gitti et al. measured a 389+/-6 kpc shock, density jump 1.43+/-0.10, Mach number 1.29+/-0.07, and an approximate 2100 km/s propagation speed.
The reported approximately 180 Myr propagation age is an upper bound under an AGN-driven interpretation, not a unique time since cluster core passage.
The same analysis states that merger and AGN origins remain unresolved, so the feature is not an identified universal assembly clock.

primary_sources.title: Deep Chandra observations of PLCKG287.0+32.9: a clear detection of a shock front in a heated former cool core

decision_rule: A present-epoch member statistic may diagnose projected substructure but cannot satisfy the time-information gate.

The history source advances only if both clusters have the same directly measured time-ordered observable, unique causal attribution, at least five-sigma significance, member and temperature uncertainty products, and a declared projection uncertainty ensemble.
Failure caused by missing or ambiguous measurements is data insufficiency, not falsification of causal-history physics.
If readiness fails, do not construct a source, access a lensing target, or derive a history-dependent field action from these data.
